landing.hero_subtitle: Automating vehicle number plate recognition, document verification and traffic violation monitoring through intelligent computer vision.
landing.pipeline_subtitle: High-throughput edge neural intelligence for roadside enforcement
landing.stage_1_desc: High-resolution camera capture with rear/front lens switching and reticle guides.
landing.stage_2_desc: Bounding-box localization trained on Indian standard High Security Registration Plates.
landing.stage_3_desc: CRAFT text detector and deep bidirectional LSTM character recognition with format normalization.
landing.stage_4_desc: Real-time cross-referencing against Central Parivahan Vahan registry for RC, Insurance, PUC & Tax.
landing.stage_5_desc: Instant automated statutory fine computation, ReportLab PDF citation, and UPI payment QR.
landing.capabilities_subtitle: Engineered for roadside enforcement and highway corridor monitoring
landing.cap_1_desc: Sub-350ms localization and character extraction using deep neural network inference.
landing.cap_2_desc: Instant verification across Registration Certificate, Insurance, PUC, and Commercial Road Tax.
landing.cap_3_desc: Itemized statutory violation calculation compliant with the Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act 2019.
landing.cap_4_desc: Cryptographically hashed PDF challans with verifiable QR code and payment gateway simulation.
landing.cap_5_desc: Dual-stage rider localization and head curvature contour analysis for two-wheeler safety.
landing.cap_6_desc: Audit-grade surveillance tracking tagged with checkpoint coordinates and duty officer timestamps.
landing.footer_rights: All rights reserved. Smart Traffic Enforcement Platform.
